title: Fix Piece Flat Plane Dependency Cache
description: Update semio/rs so PieceStore::flat_plane no longer reads DesignStore::flatten_map. Compute the flat plane directly from explicit dependencies, cache it with correct invalidation, and ensure design mutations update parent piece/connection references and invalidate derived caches when piece ancestry changes or pieces are removed.
summary: Moved piece flat-plane and flat-center derivation off DesignStore::flatten_map by introducing piece-level parent piece and parent connection references, rebuilding that ancestry on design hydration and structural graph edits, and adding regression tests for explicit child planes and deletion-driven parent rewiring.
